candidate_bindings.path: ../15-需求优先的现实实验重设计.md

major_findings.title: Unavailable or unreproducible listings are described as current requests
evidence: The Langfuse listing now redirects to a category page.
The NYC benchmarking listing now redirects to the general jobs page.
The AI SaaS QA page says the job is no longer available.
Raw response bytes, final URLs, HTTP status, screenshots, and source hashes were not persisted.
major_findings.required_fix: Downgrade these pages to historical single-point demand samples and require a fresh, directly open, content-addressed listing before any current application experiment.

major_findings.title: The proposed LLM evaluation artifact can collapse into a generic Langfuse feature demonstration
evidence: Langfuse already supplies datasets, experiments, prompt comparison, code evaluators, annotation, judges, online traces, and regression feedback loops.

The draft does not freeze a job-requirement matrix, client-specific semantics, failure taxonomy, expected outputs, objective thresholds, withheld tests, or a Langfuse-native versus custom responsibility split.
Synthetic traces cannot be represented as production-trace experience.
major_findings.required_fix: Create a closed customer-style acceptance contract tied only to a historical reference specification, with deterministic limits, withheld cases, explicit gaps, and no production-experience claim.

major_findings.title: The local experiment action envelope does not close remote service, credential, telemetry, or cost paths
evidence: Using Langfuse, a judge, or cost and latency collection can invoke cloud accounts, API keys, remote trace uploads, external models, telemetry, or fees.
The no-login statement is scoped to job applications rather than all experiment services.
major_findings.required_fix: Default the experiment to no network, no cloud account or login, no private key, no trace upload, no paid model, no telemetry, no publication, and zero external cost; require separate exact authorization for every remote service.

major_findings.title: Fraud, payment protection, and delivery-start risks are warnings rather than deterministic gates
evidence: The application packet does not require current client payment verification, spend, hire history, proposal state, free-test restrictions, or platform costs.
The contract and work-start boundaries do not separately require funded milestones or applicable hourly payment protection.
The directly open data-cleaning listing shows a newly joined client and no displayed spend or hire history; that is an unknown risk, not proof of fraud.
major_findings.required_fix: Add separate application-risk, contract-acceptance, and delivery-start gates; prohibit free tests and off-platform contact; require current payment protection evidence before work begins.

confirmed_boundaries: The candidate did not claim that a single listing proves market size.
The candidate did not recommend immediate application to the expert Langfuse, AI QA, or NYC benchmarking roles.
The candidate accurately disclosed missing production and NYC experience and the Kittle location mismatch.
No account, application, message, payment, or external action occurred during review.
claim_boundary: This is a historical independent rejection of the first demand-first redesign. It authorizes no account access, profile change, application, message, free test, Connects purchase, contract, private-data access, delivery, payment, publication, cloud service, model call, or other external action.
